description.zh: 需要接入全站加速的域名，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The accelerated domain names that you want to disable. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

descriptions.zh:
> - 停用加速域名后，加速域名的配置信息仍然会保留，但是阿里云DCDN将停止为该域名提供加速服务，且该域名会被解析到无效地址“offline.***.com”，无法被继续访问。
> - 单次配置的域名数量不超过50个。
> - 单用户调用频率：30次/秒。
descriptions.en:
> - After you disable an accelerated domain name, its configuration information is retained. However, Alibaba Cloud DCDN stops providing acceleration for the domain name. The domain name is resolved to an invalid address, \`offline.\*\*\*.com\`, and becomes inaccessible.
>
> - You can specify a maximum of 50 domain names in a single request.
>
> - The API call frequency is limited to 30 calls per second for each user.
